from pathlib import Path
import getpass,ssl,subprocess,time,json,shlex,re,tarfile,hashlib
from pyVim.connect import SmartConnect,Disconnect
w=Path(__file__).parent;lab=w.parent
kernel='7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf25';boot='/var/lib/sshpool/boot-pf25';label='SSHPool PF25 transport fence experiment'
ids=['bed141ceb5a94840930beead90b4d3a8','97609053a4db470a8a9fd24d2d2af76b']
build=json.loads((w/'pf25-build-hashes.json').read_text());archive=lab/'sources/kernel-pf25-runtime.tar.gz'
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==build['archive']
with tarfile.open(archive) as t:
 for m in t.getmembers():
  assert '..' not in Path(m.name).parts and not m.name.startswith('/')
  assert m.name.split('/')[0] in ('boot','usr')
